full_prompt_en: A square surreal landscape image brings a precise pale pyramid into a wide, sunlit field. The foreground begins with a narrow dirt track running from the lower center toward the horizon. Two small dark figures walk away from the viewer along the path, their scale emphasizing the immense breadth of the surrounding ochre and gold grass. The track visually meets the central point beneath the pyramid, whose light triangular face catches the sun while its opposite face turns cool gray. A small low structure sits far left on the horizon, nearly lost in the flat open land. Above the pyramid, layered white cumulus clouds occupy the middle distance, and a vivid cyan-blue sky fills the upper half. Hundreds of tiny warm orange and yellow flecks float over the clouds, scattered most densely near the upper center and thinning toward the sides. They appear suspended without an obvious source, shifting an otherwise plausible rural vista into an uncanny scene. The light is clear daylight from the left, with soft cloud shadows, a bright pyramid face, and gentle dark accents along the track. The image has the crisp, naturalistic surface of a staged photographic composite: the field retains fine grain and irregular vegetation, the clouds hold soft volume, and the geometric monument is sharply edged. Its palette contrasts dry amber earth with clean turquoise sky and pale white-gray stone. The horizon lies just below the midpoint, so the open sky provides a large visual stage for the small flying points. Strong central perspective and a simple triangular focal shape make the picture legible from a distance, while the unusual scale and floating flecks keep it quietly dreamlike. There is no text or decorative framing, only an expansive landscape arranged around a single improbable visual event.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实风景图像将一座边缘精确的浅色金字塔置于辽阔阳光田野中。前景以一条狭窄土路开始，从下方中央伸向地平线。两名小小的深色人物沿路背向观者而行，他们的尺度凸显周围赭黄、金色草地的广阔。道路在视觉上汇入金字塔下方的中心点；塔的一片浅色三角面承接阳光，相反一面转为冷灰。地平线左远处有一座低矮小建筑，几乎消失于平坦旷野。金字塔上方，层叠白色积云占据中景，鲜明青蓝天空填满上半部。数百个细小暖橙和黄色斑点飘浮在云层上方，在上方中央最密，向两侧变疏。它们仿佛无源地悬在空中，使原本可信的乡间景色变得奇异。清澈日光从左侧照来，云朵阴影柔软，塔面明亮，路边有轻柔深色重音。图像具有精心布置的摄影合成那种清晰写实表面：田野保留细小颗粒和不规则植物，云层有柔软体积，几何形纪念物边缘锐利。色彩以干燥琥珀色土地对照干净青绿天空与浅白灰石材。地平线略低于中点，使开阔天空成为细小飞点的大型视觉舞台。强烈中央透视和简洁三角形焦点让画面从远处也易辨认，而异常尺度与悬浮色点带来安静梦境感。画面没有文字或装饰边框，只有围绕单一不可思议事件布置的辽阔风景。
style_prompt_en: A naturalistic photographic composite pairs expansive open space with one stark, cleanly bounded geometric form. Strong central perspective pulls the eye from a low, textured foreground to a distant point at the horizon. Dry amber and ochre areas contrast with a saturated cyan-blue upper field and broad, softly volumetric white forms. Small warm flecks drift through otherwise empty upper space, creating an uncanny interruption without crowding the composition. Clear daylight gives one planar face a bright value and turns another cool and gray, while fine ground textures remain visible. The horizon is low enough to give the upper region breadth. Sharp engineered edges, granular natural surfaces, and soft atmospheric masses coexist in a poised, quiet, dreamlike arrangement.
style_prompt_zh: 自然写实的摄影合成把辽阔空地与一个边界干净、突出的几何形体并置。强烈中央透视将目光从低处有纹理的前景引向地平线远点。干燥琥珀与赭黄色区域对照饱和青蓝色上方色域和宽阔、柔软而有体积的白色形团。细小暖色斑点漂浮在其余空旷的上部空间，造成奇异打断，却不使构图拥挤。清澈日光让一个平面明亮，另一面转为冷灰，同时保留地面细颗粒。较低地平线给上方区域留下宽度。锐利人工边缘、细粒自然表面与柔和大气团块并存，形成端正、安静且如梦的安排。
theme_en: Two distant walkers approach a white pyramid across a golden field beneath a sky full of tiny floating objects
theme_zh: 两名远处行人穿过金色田野走向白色金字塔，天空飘满细小物体
name: Storm Thorgerson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
